rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for selling goods to foreign markets.

example.english: We export fresh fruit to Southeast Asia.

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the act of exporting.

example.english: Export has been doing well this year.
example.jyutping: gam1 nin4 ceot1 hau2 zou6 dak1 gei2 hou2

rows.note: Use this more formal term for the act of exporting, especially in business or official contexts.

example.english: The report says Hong Kong export increased compared with last year.
example.traditional: 報告指出，本港輸出較上年增加。
example.jyutping: bou3 gou3 zi2 ceot1 bun2 gong2 syu1 ceot1 gaau3 soeng6 nin2 zang1 gaa1

rows.note: Use this for sending data or files out of one program or system into another.

example.english: I usually export the report first, then send it to the accounting department.

rows.note: Use this for goods that are exported, rather than for the act itself.

example.english: This batch of export goods has already been loaded onto the ship.
example.traditional: 呢批出口貨已經上船喇。
example.jyutping: ne1 pai1 ceot1 hau2 fo3 ji5 ging1 soeng5 syun4 laa3
